text:
Emma (Partnerships): Quick sync — final checklist for marketplace launch (press, blog, LPs). Can we confirm owners + hard deadlines?
Josh (Marketing): I can own blog + social. Need final assets by Thu COB.
Rachel (Press): Press release draft is at 80% — waiting on partner quote + one product stat from Dave.
Dave (Product): I can give a 1-2 sentence quote and the latency/cost metric. Will drop both by Wed noon.
Katie (Design): Design will deliver LP hero + 1-pager PDF by Wed EOD. Need direction on hero treatment (partner co-brand vs Redwood-first).
Emma (Partnerships): Timeline proposal: Wed — design & partner quotes, Thu — final assets + QA, Fri 09:00 PT embargo lift / publish. Partner approvals must be in by Thu 12:00 PT.
Josh (Marketing): Embargo Fri 09:00 PT works for us. Social toolkit ready to go once assets land.
Sam (Eng): Integration tests green for marketplace listing. I can spin a staging LP with demo flow. Need the SVG logos and sample copy.
Emma (Partnerships): @Sam please create staging link and share creds in 1Password; tag partner PMs for smoke once up.
Sam (Eng): Will do. Staging URL: https://staging-marketplace.redwood.internal — creds in 1Password under Marketplace/Launch. Quick demo curl for QA:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <staging-token>" https://staging-marketplace.redwood.internal/api/listings/preview
```
Rachel (Press): Also: include partner PR contacts in the distribution list. @Emma — did you get Acme and CloudCorp PR leads?
Emma (Partnerships): Yep, pinged both earlier and shared a quote template: "We partnered with Redwood to ... simplify inference at scale" — sending again in thread.
Josh (Marketing): For LP copy we need: 50-75 word hero blurb, 3 benefit bullets, 2 CTAs (Contact Sales / Try Demo). Who owns the hero headline options?
Katie (Design): I have 3 headline options coming: 1) "Production-grade LLM inference in the cloud" 2) "Predictable inference at scale" 3) "Bring LLMs to production faster" Leaning to option 1 for visual pairing.
Dave (Product): Option 1 works. For bullets, use: low latency SLA, predictable unit economics, private deployment options. I'll refine.
Josh (Marketing): I'll draft the blog outline and long-form copy. ETA Thu morning for review.
Rachel (Press): PR checklist: embargo time, one partner quote, senior exec quote (Dave), high-res logos (SVG/PNG), product stat, and spokespeople availability.
Emma (Partnerships): Action items: 
- Katie: hero + mockups (Wed EOD)
- Dave: quote + stat (Wed noon)
- Josh: blog + social kit (Thu morning)
- Sam: staging link + test data (Wed afternoon)
- Rachel: finalize press list & embargo plan (Thu morning)
- Emma: coordinate partner approvals + send quote template (in progress)
press-bot: :information_source: PR distro list updated (partners included). Reminder set for Thu 11:30 PT to escalate missing approvals.
Josh (Marketing): One more ask — can we get a 2-line partner blurb from each partner (for LP co-brand area)? Otherwise we'll craft but prefer their language.
Emma (Partnerships): Already requested. Acme said maybe by Tue EOD, CloudCorp by Wed.
Sam (Eng): Small note — the listing metadata field length is 160 chars for summary; keep hero blurb under that for metadata.
Katie (Design): Good call. I'll keep the meta copy short and provide a separate 50-75 word hero as requested.
Rachel (Press): Plan to send embargoed release to reporters Fri 08:30 PT so they have 30 min to queue. Any objections?
Josh (Marketing): Sounds good. We'll schedule socials for 09:00 PT publish.
Dave (Product): I'll be available for media calls Fri morning.
Emma (Partnerships): Great — next check-in Thu 11:00 PT to confirm approvals and handoff assets. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup: 
Katie (Design): :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng)::+1:
Rachel (Press)::+1:
Emma (Partnerships): Thanks all — sending consolidated timeline + checklist to partners and ops now.
